summary: Safe Bulkers, Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Euronext Athens listing prospectus for the parallel listing of its existing 101,826,580 common shares on the Main Market of Euronext Athens, while its shares remain primarily listed on the NYSE. No new shares are issued, no capital is raised, and no terms such as price per share, premium, or timeline beyond the expected June 2, 2026 trading commencement are disclosed. The board approved the listing on April 1, 2026, and the prospectus is approved by the Hellenic Capital Market Commission. There is no special-situation catalyst; this is an ordinary secondary listing.
